items.name: Un vrai boulot : des soignants pas comme les autres
items.original_name: Un vrai boulot : des soignants pas comme les autres
items.overview: Laurent Ournac, Virginie Hocq, Delphine de Saxe-Cobourg, Jill Vandermeulen, and Henri PFR have agreed to step into the shoes of a nurse. To kick off this adventure, the five celebrities begin their journey at the CHC MontLégia clinic, where they undergo practical training and learn which department they have been assigned to. The news sparks excitement in some, while for others, it causes stress levels to soar. Following an early wake-up call, they begin their very first shift. They are introduced to the mentors who will guide them throughout their placement and then meet their patients—a deep dive into the reality of the profession, with a long day only just getting underway.

items.name: Missie Verhulst
items.overview: Gert and Viktor Verhulst have a new mission: to mercilessly prank well-known Flemish and Dutch celebrities. With hidden cameras, meticulously crafted plans, and help from unexpected quarters, the father-son duo pulls out all the stops to lure their friends into a trap.

items.name: Jeugdpsychiaters
items.overview:
Gilles De Coster engages in conversation with seven child and adolescent psychiatrists. They share personal accounts of the challenges they face and what it is like to practice their profession.

*Jeugdpsychiaters* (Child and Adolescent Psychiatrists) is a four-part interview series exploring both the individuals and their craft—much like previous VRT Canvas series such as *Strafpleiters* (Criminal Defense Lawyers), *Misdaaddokters* (Forensic Doctors), and *Sekswerkers* (Sex Workers).

items.name: Shinji: Double Shuffle
items.overview: Reborn with memories of a forbidden love, a man pursues his former lover again, only to find him cold, distant, and changed.

items.name: Nine to Six
items.overview: Falsely blamed for a car fire, Chronic Motors Senior Manager Kang Yi-ji faces demotion. Can she find love and happiness amid office politics?

items.name: Natt Bi
items.overview: Ndeye Penda, a respected grande dame, manages the tontine fund, and the whole neighborhood entrusts her with their savings. Adja Fama has convinced the others to contribute. Nafy has just arrived and is causing quite a stir. The day the fund is stolen, everyone is asking questions, and each person has something to hide. Who took the money? Who will pay the victims?

items.name: Bonus Leveling
items.overview: A group of handpicked celebrities become “players” and are transported against their will to a mysterious world where they must compete in a series of games. The only way to survive is to play—and spin the Wheel of Fate. Winners get a chance to claim prizes or the jackpot, while the wheel decides the level of punishment for those who lose.

items.name: Prue and Sandi's South African Adventure
items.original_name: Prue and Sandi's South African Adventure
items.overview: Long term pals Prue Leith & Sandi Toksvig are finally embarking on the trip of a lifetime together. Prue’s South African roots have defined her life and career. Now, she’s taking Sandi on and off the beaten track to discover the best the country has to offer. They travel from Cape Town, where Prue was born, to Johannesburg, where she grew up. Packed full of fascinating facts and personal anecdotes, each episode explores the history, nature, politics, culture and food of the places they visit. There’s hands-on activity, from wine sabrage to fishing, as they’re guided by fascinating locals, artisans and experts. Whether it’s by boat, balloon, quad bike, or safari vehicle, Prue and Sandi experience a journey they’ll never forget, and inspire others to do the same.

items.overview: ABNORMAL ACTIVITIES, a series by Arham under STARLIGHT STUDIOS, follows two friends, MIKE and LINA, along with their classmates. Their lives turn into a nightmare when they find themselves trapped in a terrifying situation where someone is killing their classmates one by one. As they try to uncover the truth, they discover that the killer is none other than LINA, who is actually a clown with mysterious powers. The shocking truth leaves everyone stunned.

items.name: Lawless: A Journey into No-Go Zones
items.original_name: Senza Legge: Viaggio nelle No-Go Zones
items.overview: Giuseppe, a reporter and documentarian for the YouTube channel Progetto Happiness, embarks on a journey into the heart of so-called "no-go zones"—territories where the state fails to exert control, and where gangs, drug traffickers, and criminal organizations dictate the law. These are places where violence is a part of daily life, and entire communities live by rules imposed by those who hold power over the territory. The journey takes him from the streets of Cali, Colombia—where over a hundred gangs vie for control of entire neighborhoods—to Bogotá, where Giuseppe spends a night among the pandilleros, the young outlaws of the capital.

Seventeen-year-old Veer Singh's life changes forever when an extraordinary alien device known as Xion bonds with his chest, awakening powers beyond human comprehension. items.name: Big Teens Naija
items.overview:
Big Teens Naija is a Nigerian youth reality television show designed to discover, nurture, celebrate and showcase the talents, creativity, intelligence and ingenuity of young Nigerians between the ages of 13 and 19.

Built around the theme “Ingenuity of the African Child,” the show brings together teenagers from diverse backgrounds to live, learn, compete and collaborate in a structured and entertaining reality-TV environment.

Through talent showcases, creative and intellectual challenges, team activities, entrepreneurship, leadership tasks and other engaging competitions, contestants will have the opportunity to express themselves, discover their strengths, develop confidence and build valuable life skills.

An independent Armenia, two influential families, and a single story intertwined with the pivotal historical events of the early 20th century.

A murder that forever changes the fate of both families. Their children, Sona and Varuzhan, set out to find their own paths to independence.

Crimes whose consequences will affect everyone, and for which many will share responsibility.

results.name: Big Teens Naija
results.overview:
Big Teens Naija is a Nigerian youth reality television show designed to discover, nurture, celebrate and showcase the talents, creativity, intelligence and ingenuity of young Nigerians between the ages of 13 and 19.

Built around the theme “Ingenuity of the African Child,” the show brings together teenagers from diverse backgrounds to live, learn, compete and collaborate in a structured and entertaining reality-TV environment.

Through talent showcases, creative and intellectual challenges, team activities, entrepreneurship, leadership tasks and other engaging competitions, contestants will have the opportunity to express themselves, discover their strengths, develop confidence and build valuable life skills.
